literals.reason: Docker Compose development credential for the bundled "Lumen Supply" demo database, which must stay literal in the committed example environment, the CI end-to-end job and the documentation so `pnpm demo:db` works on a fresh clone; it authenticates only against a throwaway local container and grants access to nothing else.

Password half of that same throwaway local PostgreSQL container, declared literally in the Compose service and the CI service container because interpolating it would break `pnpm demo:db` on a clone that has no .env file.

notes: Hand-reviewed allowlist read by scripts/check-secrets.mjs. It holds exactly the two development placeholders the product requires to be committed and is not a general escape hatch: `value` must match the committed bytes character for character and cover the whole matched value (a match is exempt only when it lies entirely inside an occurrence of the literal and that occurrence is the whole value on its line, followed by nothing but closing punctuation before whitespace, a quote, a backtick or the end of the line, so a longer value that contains it, such as the URL with a query, path parameter, path, fragment or scheme prefix added, is still a finding); `files` lists every repository-relative path where that literal is permitted (an occurrence anywhere else is still a failure, and wildcards are not supported), and each entry names this file itself because the literals are necessarily committed here too. Any addition needs a written justification in review, and a real credential must never be added - this file is scanned like every other tracked file.
